name: 7 Days of Summer: Lost Alpha
storyline: The protagonist of «7 Summer Days: Lost Alpha» is a young man leading a withdrawn lifestyle. Everything changes one night on New Year's Eve, when he decides to leave his house and go out, but instead finds himself in a camp already familiar to the reader.
summary:
"7 Days of Summer: Lost Alpha (7DS: LA)" is a modification for "Everlasting Summer," offering an alternative take on both the story and the universe of the original game. It features a new original storyline, numerous new illustrations, and a reimagined musical accompaniment.
At first glance, the story repeats itself: the bus, the camp, the girls... And yet, the minor differences gradually accumulate to grow into an entirely new story. A major role in this is played by our protagonist (or rather, protagonists): he differs from the usual Semyon, which is why his story is different. Meanwhile, rumors are spreading throughout the camp that our hero is not quite an ordinary pioneer...
